description:
Senior C++ Developer 
  - On behalf of our client in the Oil and Gas sector, Procom Services is looking for 2 C++ Developers for a 6 month contract in Houston TX. The successfully candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of experience with C/C++ in a large project environment. 

 

 Senior C++ Developer Job Details 
 Work on a critical project to meet regulatory requirements (FERC 809 and NAESB 3.0) for our client’s legacy US Commercial Transactional applications.
 

 Senior C++ Developer Mandatory Skills 
 
 

 
 5 years of experience with C/C++.
 SQL Server
 Stored Procedures and SQL Development
  
 Senior C++ Developer Nice to Have Skills 
 

 FERC Regulatory Compliance Experience 
  
 Senior C++ Developer Start Date 
 October 26, 2015
 

 Senior C++ Developer Assignment Length 
 

 6 month contract
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
